If you have a Netgear router, you can go to the Advanced tab, then "Advanced Setup", and then "Traffic Meter" and check "Enable Traffic Meter", which will log to a table at the bottom of the page your usage statistics for the current day, previous day, week to date, month to date, and previous month.
